tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Fallback/non-widget tool for sending after payment is authorized and the user explicitly wants to send now. In ChatGPT widget sessions, do not call this after start_session unless the widget is unavailable or the user explicitly asks for fallback behavior.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Use this when you need the latest PromptFax workflow state, quote/payment state, or fax transmission status.

tools.name: retry_failed_fax
tools.description: Use this after a retry-eligible failed fax to queue another attempt under the existing authorization. You may supply a corrected destination.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Use this when you need to cancel the active PromptFax send.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_session, get_quote · Private data: start_session, attach_document, get_quote · Public sink: start_session, checkout, send_fax, cancel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_session, get_quote · Private data: start_session, attach_document, get_quote · Public sink: start_session, checkout, send_fax, cancel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
